plan.summary: BRO-5858 (part 4/4): same-url pairs where the right-critic file pointed duplicateTextOf at the wrong-critic file, which holds the text. Keep the text-holding file and set its criticName to the critic the page byline or aggregator excerpt names, and retire the other file as duplicateOf it (the reverse would close a pointer cycle). See the BRO-5858 change table.
steps: Set criticName on the text-holding file to the attested critic
Mark the other file duplicateOf the text-holding file
